package rulefixtures

import (
	"database/sql"
	"log"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for middleware_starts_db_transaction: Middleware that opens database transactions for the whole request path by default.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: warning.

var appDB *sql.DB

func TxWrapMiddleware(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		tx, err := appDB.Begin()
		if err != nil {
			http.Error(w, "could not begin tx", http.StatusInternalServerError)
			return
		}

		arw := &txResponseWriter{ResponseWriter: w, tx: tx}

		defer func() {
			if p := recover(); p != nil {
				if rbErr := tx.Rollback(); rbErr != nil {
					log.Printf("rollback panic: %v", rbErr)
				}
				panic(p)
			}
		}()

		next.ServeHTTP(arw, r)

		if arw.failed {
			if rbErr := tx.Rollback(); rbErr != nil {
				log.Printf("rollback failed: %v", rbErr)
			}
			return
		}
		if cmErr := tx.Commit(); cmErr != nil {
			log.Printf("commit failed: %v", cmErr)
			tx.Rollback()
		}
	})
}

type txResponseWriter struct {
	http.ResponseWriter
	tx     *sql.Tx
	failed bool
}

func (w *txResponseWriter) WriteHeader(code int) {
	if code >= 400 {
		w.failed = true
	}
	w.ResponseWriter.WriteHeader(code)
}

var _ = log.Println
